title: CAS Formal Substrate Manifest
description: Version tracking and schema inventory for the CAS Formal Substrate (CAS-ADR-008). The manifest records which schemas are present in each version, their status, and their role within the substrate.

organization.description: The formal substrate is organized by component (SAGE, ROOT Harness) with domain-specific configuration files produced by domain instantiation documents. Each component directory contains configuration schemas (JSON Schema), API operation contracts (OpenAPI 3.1.0), and data model schemas (JSON Schema) as appropriate.

structure.sage/: SAGE configuration schemas, Core API OpenAPI specification, and data model schemas. vault_config.schema.json is the root configuration schema; it $ref's to the five sub-schemas.
structure.root_harness/: ROOT Harness configuration schemas, Orchestration API OpenAPI specification, event stream schema, and interrupt contracts.

schemas.title: SAGE Vault Configuration
schemas.role: Root schema for SAGE vault configuration. A domain instantiation produces a single YAML file that validates against this schema.

schemas.title: SAGE Document Types
schemas.role: Defines the doc_type enum for a vault's domain vocabulary. Sole Tier 2 metadata field.

schemas.title: SAGE Lifecycle State Machine
schemas.role: Defines lifecycle states and valid transitions. Base set is always present; domains extend it.

schemas.title: SAGE Source Adapter Configuration
schemas.role: Defines which source adapters are enabled for a vault and their per-adapter configuration.

schemas.title: SAGE Metadata Extraction Configuration
schemas.role: Defines the two-stage metadata extraction pipeline: filename patterns with code-to-doc_type maps, then content extraction rules.

schemas.title: SAGE Edge Inference Configuration
schemas.role: Defines three-tier edge inference model: tier assignments, inference rules, and staging table behavior.

schemas.title: SAGE Core API
schemas.role: OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification for the SAGE Core API. Defines the REST surface for discovery, ingestion, lifecycle management, graph operations, access control, and utilities. Consumed by the ROOT Harness Integration Layer, MCP adapter, and CAS Application. Source authority: SAGE Architecture Reference Section 7.

schemas.title: Decision Log
schemas.role: Schema for SAGE-managed decision logs owned by steward and orchestrator agents. Captures operational judgment not recorded in artifact revision histories: decisions not to act, decisions deferred, and cross-artifact reasoning. Append-only with supersession back-references. See CAS-ADR-012.

schemas.title: ROOT Harness Pipeline Configuration
schemas.role: Defines pipeline stages, transitions, gatekeeper bindings, and precondition expressions.

schemas.title: ROOT Harness Agent Registration
schemas.role: Defines agent registration records: type, owned artifact, autonomy level, capabilities, policy reference, LLM configuration.

schemas.title: ROOT Harness Policy Configuration
schemas.role: Defines behavioral constraints: permitted operations, scope restrictions, and tool-level approval policy.

schemas.title: ROOT Harness Workflow Graph
schemas.role: Defines LangGraph workflow definitions: nodes, edges, state dictionary, and interrupt placement.

schemas.title: ROOT Harness Orchestration API
schemas.role: OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification for the ROOT Harness Orchestration API. Defines the REST surface for workflow triggering, status monitoring, human-in-the-loop interrupt resolution, agent registration, pipeline status queries, and real-time event streaming. Consumed by the CAS Application, MCP adapter, and CLI. Source authority: ROOT Harness Architecture Reference Section 2.5.

schemas.title: AgentEvent
schemas.role: Schema for typed event records emitted by the ROOT Harness event stream during workflow execution. Seven event categories: workflow lifecycle, node transitions, tool interactions, LLM cycles, interrupt lifecycle, steward governance, and checkpoint operations. Consumed by the CAS Application and MCP clients via subscribe_events. See CAS-ADR-013.

schemas.title: Interrupt Contracts
schemas.role: Schema for human-in-the-loop interrupt descriptors and tool-level approval policies. Defines InterruptDescriptor (runtime data structure for pending interrupts), ApproveRequest (resolution payload for the approve operation), and ApprovalPolicy (per-agent configuration for tool-call approval gating). Two interrupt origins: interrupt nodes (autonomy Level 3) and approval callbacks (Levels 1-2). See ROOT Harness Architecture Reference Sections 2.5, 2.7, 4.4, and 5.2.

revision_history.summary: Initial draft. Ten configuration schemas across SAGE (6) and ROOT Harness (4), covering all twelve items in the ROOT Harness instantiation checklist. JSON Schema draft 2020-12. API operation contracts deferred to v0.2. Developed against SAGE Architecture Reference v1.3 and ROOT Harness Architecture Reference v0.5.

API contracts and data model schemas. Added five artifacts resolving all deferred items from v0.1: (1) SAGE Core API OpenAPI specification (sage/sage_core_api.openapi.yaml), 14 operations across 7 tags, developed against SAGE Architecture Reference v1.4 Section 7. (2) ROOT Harness Orchestration API OpenAPI specification (root_harness/orchestration_api.openapi.yaml), 9 operations across 5 tags, developed against ROOT Harness Architecture Reference v1.0 Section 2.5. (3) Event stream schema (root_harness/event_stream.schema.json), 15 event types in 7 categories per CAS-ADR-013. (4) Interrupt contracts and approval policy schema (root_harness/interrupt.schema.json), covering InterruptDescriptor, ApproveRequest, ApprovalPolicy, and supporting types. (5) Decision log schema (sage/decision_log.schema.json), three entry categories per CAS-ADR-012. Promoted to v1.0: all contributions listed in SAGE Architecture Reference Section 8.3 and ROOT Harness Architecture Reference Section 8.2 are present with no known gaps.

SAGE tier 2 behavioral design decisions applied to schemas. Seven changes to sage_core_api.openapi.yaml and vault_config.schema.json: (1) Document.indexed_at changed from required to nullable (null until indexing completes). (2) Document.pipeline_error added as nullable string (failure description when pipeline_status is failed). (3) Edge.id added as required auto-generated field (enables duplicate edge disambiguation). (4) TraversalNode.edge_count added (deduplication signal for traversal results). (5) IngestRequest.force added as boolean (bypasses duplicate detection for pipeline failure recovery). (6) SetLifecycleResponse schema added with optional warnings array (pipeline status advisory). (7) vault_config.schema.json: retrieval_health section added with assertions_file field. Also added 409 duplicate content response to ingest endpoint. Updated abstraction.enabled description to reflect strict quality gate decision (LLM failure = failed, not skipped).

Edge inference schema support. Three changes for the CAS Application's filename-aware scan and bulk ingest workflow: (1) metadata_extraction.schema.json: added known_code_patterns (regex list for code segment recognition during tolerant filename parsing, independent of doc_type mapping) and keyword_to_doc_type (keyword-based doc_type mapping evaluated before code_to_doc_type, resolves mis-classification of workflow artifacts containing domain-specific codes). Updated filename_extraction description to document tolerant parser behavior. Updated code_to_doc_type description to clarify evaluation order relative to keyword_to_doc_type. (2) sage_core_api.openapi.yaml: added metadata property to IngestRequest (optional string-valued object for caller-supplied metadata fields from parsed filename segments, participates in standard precedence chain). Enables single-call ingestion with metadata instead of separate ingest + update_metadata.

Catalog mode and discovery improvements. Three changes to sage_core_api.openapi.yaml: (1) RetrievalMode enum: added 'catalog' (filter-only SQL enumeration, no vector search, returns document metadata only) and 'keyword' (BM25-only search, was in code but missing from spec). (2) DiscoverRequest: added 'offset' integer property (pagination for catalog mode, default 0). Updated description to document all five modes. (3) RetrievalFilters: added 'pipeline_status' string property (was in code but missing from spec; overrides default failed-pipeline exclusion).
